title: An end-of-course activity
context_es: Tu profesora de inglés, la señora Evans, ha escrito a la clase proponiendo una actividad de fin de curso. Tienes que contestarle.
prompt_en:
Read this email from your English teacher, Mrs Evans:

"Our course finishes next month and I would like to organise something special for the last day. We could go to the theatre to see a play in English or have a picnic in the park. Which would you prefer, and why? Is there a day that is better for you? Any other ideas are welcome!"

Write your email to Mrs Evans.
points: say which activity you prefer and why
say which day is best for you
useful_language: I think it is a wonderful idea to …
I look forward to hearing from you.
tips_es: Escribes a tu profesora: tono educado, sin jerga, con *Dear …* y *Best wishes*.
Para preferencias: *I would prefer to* + verbo o *I would rather* + verbo sin *to*.
Responde a todas sus preguntas, en el mismo orden en que las hace.
model_answer:
Dear Mrs Evans,

Thank you for your email. I think it is a wonderful idea to do something special on the last day of the course.

I would prefer to go to the theatre, because it would be a good opportunity to practise our listening. Although a picnic sounds fun, the weather is not very reliable in June, and it would be a pity to cancel it because of the rain.

As for the day, Thursday would be best for me, since I work on Friday evenings. However, I could change my shift if most people prefer Friday.

Perhaps we could also have a drink together after the play. That way, we would have time to talk about it in English.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Best wishes,
Javier Ortega
